name: Tempus AI, Inc.
blurb: Tempus AI applies machine learning to clinical and genomic data to advance precision medicine — the practice of tailoring medical treatment to individual patients based on their genetic and molecular profiles. The company operates in oncology, cardiology, radiology, and neuropsychiatry, offering genomic sequencing diagnostics, AI-powered clinical decision tools, and a proprietary data platform that it licenses to pharmaceutical companies for drug discovery. Founded in 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky (co-founder of Groupon), Tempus went public in June 2024.
recent: Tempus reported FY2025 revenue of $1.27 billion, an 83% increase year-on-year, driven by its data and genomics segments. The company narrowed losses to -$245 million. Management guided for 25% revenue growth in 2026 and positive adjusted EBITDA of $65 million. Paul Pelosi exercised call options with a $20 strike (purchased January 2025, exercised January 2026), with TEM shares returning approximately 121% over that period — the strongest performer in the disclosure batch.
